svg.title: release-rollback

g.text: runs deploy with the action rollback
Oracle Cloud VM: deploy/deploy.sh (the deploy key's forced command; one deploy at a time by flock)
Nightly backup: ecofate-backup.timer at 03:15 UTC runs deploy/backup.sh
